Class ProfileValidator

java.lang.Object
com.kineticfitness.service.ProfileValidator
public final class ProfileValidator extends Object
The rules the profile form must satisfy, and the parsing of its free-text height and weight fields.

Both the create form and the edit form call this, so the two screens can no longer drift apart on what counts as a valid profile. Pure functions, with today passed in so the "not in the future" rule is testable.

US-04 — Create a profile. US-05 — View and edit my profile.
